events.title: RSO Drop-In Advising
events.description: The Student Activities Office (SAO) offers RSO Drop-In Advising hours in HUB 111B, located within the RSO Resource Center. These drop-in hours provide RSOs with an opportunity to connect with an SAO Advisor, ask questions, and receive guidance and support on a variety of topics.

events.title: RSO Listening Session
events.description: You're invited to a listening session on the proposed changes to the student code of conduct as they relate to RSOs. University Administrators will explain the proposed changes and collect feedback from student leaders.

events.title: Fall Networking Night
events.description: OSCMC's Fall Networking Night! Join us on Thursday for an evening full of meaningful conversations and supply chain insights

events.title: Krispy Kreme Donut Fundraiser!

events.description: Friday, November 6th from 9:30-2pm we will be having a donut fundraiser in Red Square! Come stop by to buy a donut and learn about what we do! In the addition to buying a donut you can join the raffle for a $50 Little Thai Restaurant gift certificate! Hope to see you there!

events.title: Chinese Translation Club Meeting
events.description: Meet at Fridays at 3pm in the Asian Languages & Literature Department Lounge (M218) of Gowen Hall. All are welcome!

events.title: Xfinity Run It Back Cosplay Contest
events.description:
Ever thought about entering a cosplay contest? Now is your chance! Show off your cosplay, get feedback from masters-level judges, and meet fellow cosplayers. Cosplays do NOT have to be handmade! Prizes to be announced soon.
Please register for the competition using the google form attached.

events.title: UTS Town Hall
events.description: All UTS members are welcome to attend UTS's first Town Hall! This event will be an insight into the functions and ongoings of the UTS Board and an opportunity for community members to voice any concerns for the club's future and ask questions to the Board directly.

events.title: Ghostlight
events.description: All members of the drama community are welcome to attend UTS's fun and low-stakes acting opportunity Ghostlight! Attendees can bring their favorite scenes from movies and shows they've been wanting to perform, or use scenes that we provide. We'll take turns performing with partners and random groups and cheer our fellow actors on. And, be sure to attend our first Town Hall meeting right before Ghostlight at 6pm to hear about more fun events in the future!

events.title: Info Night #2
events.description:
The lights are soft, the spotlight is waiting, and your HK era might be closer than you think. ♡₊˚

Ever wondered what Hoa Khoi Lien Truong (HK) is all about? Whether you’re curious about the experience, what being a contestant involves, or what you can gain from participating, come join us for an HK Info Night!

This opportunity is open to female-identifying members of VSAUW! ♡ Whether you’re considering becoming a contestant or simply want to learn more, come with your questions and a little curiosity. Learn about the show, meet others who are interested, and discover what this experience could look like for you. ✧

✦ INFO NIGHT #1: IN-PERSON
♡ Date: Monday, November 2nd
♡ Time: 6:00–7:00 PM
♡ Location: SAV 168

✦ INFO NIGHT #2: ONLINE
♡ Date: Friday, November 6th
♡ Time: 9:00–10:00 PM
♡ Location: Zoom Link Through LinkTree

Both sessions will cover the same information, so choose whichever works best for you. However, YOU MUST ATTEND ONE INFO SESSION to qualify for HK.

If you’ve been curious about HK, consider this your sign to come learn more. Your next chapter might be waiting in the spotlight. ⋆౨ৎ˚⟡˖

We can’t wait to see you there! ♡

Graphics By: Kaitlyn Liu
#vsauw

events.title: Product Games
events.description:
Get ready for THE PRODUCT GAMES! 🚀🎯🏹

Registration is now OPEN for The Product Games, a one-day product competition combining the strategy of a case competition with the rapid building of a hackathon! 

Work in teams of 4 to tackle a real-world product challenge, build an innovative solution, and pitch your ideas to industry judges! Plus, enjoy free food, swag, mentorship, networking opportunities, and a chance to win prizes! 🏆

Event Details:
📅 Date: Saturday, November 7 | 9 AM – 5:30 PM
📍 Location: Founders Hall, UW
👥 Eligibility: Open to all UW students, regardless of major or experience
🔗 Applications are OPEN NOW, and close October 26 at 11:59 PM

Spots are limited, so don’t miss your chance! Apply through the link in our bio or scan the QR code to register!

events.title: Med Connect: Connecting You to Healthcare
events.description:
Interested in healthcare? We can connect you!
Our mission is to break down barriers to healthcare experiences at UW by connecting students with meaningful opportunities and equipping them with the skills to succeed in empathetic, compassionate healthcare.
Whether you’re pre-med, pre-nursing, pre-PA, pre-pharmacy, or simply interested in getting involved in healthcare, we’re here to help guide you toward your goals.
Come meet fellow students, learn about upcoming clinical, volunteering, shadowing, and research opportunities, and discover how MedConnect can help you take the next step in your healthcare journey!

events.title: WashPIRG CORE Meeting
events.description: Come hang out with WashPIRG on Mondays, 6:30pm-8:00pm in MEB 238! We're a student advocacy group focused on environmental and social justice causes! At CORE meetings, we discuss upcoming events, plans, and ideas. These weekly meetings give space for our different campaigns to work on their goals throughout the quarter.

events.title: TA Social
events.description:
Join us for the Association for Computing Education (ACE) monthly TA Social: November edition!

Come take a break and join us for plenty of snacks, a huge selection of board games and playing cards (like Jenga, Scrabble, UNO, and Monopoly) and our creative activities of the month: rhinestoning, loom bracelet making, painting, fuse beading, and other arts and crafts! This is the perfect time to make friends, bond, and enjoy some great company.

Whether you are a TA, are considering becoming one, or simply want to mingle with the computing education community, the ACE team welcomes you! This event is open to everyone.

📅 Date: Thursday, November 19th
🕔 Time: 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM
📍 Location: CSE1 305 (Allen)
*Please remember to RSVP at the link in our bio!*

- ACE Officers

If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to contact us at ace-officers@cs.washington.edu. ACE is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for our events, programs, activities, and education for individuals with disabilities (with advance notice). Please reach out to Linda Taing, Senior Student Leadership Development Specialist, directly at lindavt@cs.washington.edu if you have any questions or requests.

events.title: Computing Bee
events.description:
Think you can spell out the perfect end to your quarter? The Association for Computing Education (ACE) is wrapping up the quarter with our first-ever Computing Bee.

To unwind right before dead week, we are putting together a fun computing education twist on the classic spelling bee. You and a group will team up to compete in a thrilling series of computing-themed games, earning points along the way to win some awesome prizes. Prizes will range from squish toys and goodie bags, all the way up to the ultimate prize: getting to pie our ACE President, Nichole!

So whether you are yearning for the title of first place, want to participate in some fun games, or simply want to destress from exams, come take a break and join us for plenty of snacks, drinks, prizes, and fun! Everyone is welcome!

📅 Date: Tuesday, December 1st
🕔 Time: 4:00 PM to 6:30 PM
📍 Location: Gates Common (CSE1 691)
*Please remember to RSVP at the link in our bio!*

- ACE Officers

If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to contact us at ace-officers@cs.washington.edu. ACE is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for our events, programs, activities, and education for individuals with disabilities (with advance notice). Please reach out to Linda Taing, Senior Student Leadership Development Specialist, directly at lindavt@cs.washington.edu if you have any questions or requests.
